3924170 3885047  3468  0.0   50161 Ss   /bin/bash -c cd /tmp/sf-2865 && cat > scripts/base_proof_cache.py <<'PY' #!/usr/bin/env python3 import argparse import io import json import os import shutil import sys import tempfile import urllib.request import zipfile from pathlib import Path  API = "https://api.github.com" PREFIX = "base-proof-v1" PROOF = "proof-base"   def artifact_name(base_sha, digest):     return f"{PREFIX}-{base_sha}-{digest}"   def headers(token):     return {         "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",         "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",         "User-Agent": "sf-companion-base-proof-cache",         "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",     }   def github_json(url, token):     request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers(token))     with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:         return json.load(response)   def github_bytes(url, token):     request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers(token))     with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:         return response.read()   def saved_artifacts(repo, name, token, fetch_json=github_json):     found = []     page = 1     while True:         payload = fetch_json(             f"{API}/repos/{repo}/actions/artifacts?name={name}&per_page=100&page={page}",             token,         )         batch = payload.get("artifacts") or []         found.extend(             artifact             for artifact in batch             if artifact.get("name") == name and not artifact.get("expired")         )         if not batch or len(found) >= (payload.get("total_count") or 0):             return found         page += 1   def newest(artifacts):     if not artifacts:         return None     return max(artifacts, key=lambda artifact: artifact.get("created_at") or "")   def place(archive, proof_dir):     holding = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="base-proof-cache."))     try:         with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as bundle:             bundle.extractall(holding)         candidates = [holding] + sorted(             path for path in holding.iterdir() if path.is_dir()         )         for candidate in candidates:             if not (candidate / "result.json").is_file():                 continue             if proof_dir.exists():                 shutil.rmtree(proof_dir)             proof_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)             shutil.move(str(candidate), str(proof_dir))             return True         return False     finally:         shutil.rmtree(holding, ignore_errors=True)   def report(output, result):     if output is None:         return     lines = [f"hit={'true' if result['hit'] else 'false'}"]     if result["run"]:         lines.append(f"run={result['run']}")     output.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")   def restore(repo, base_sha, digest, proof_dir, token, output=None, fetch_json=None, fetch_zip=None):     fetch_json = fetch_json or github_json     fetch_zip = fetch_zip or github_bytes     name = artifact_name(base_sha, digest)     try:         chosen = newest(saved_artifacts(repo, name, token, fetch_json))     except OSError as error:         return miss(output, f"base proof cache miss: could not ask GitHub for {name}: {error}")     if chosen is None:         return miss(output, f"base proof cache miss: no earlier run saved {name}")     run = str((chosen.get("workflow_run") or {}).get("id") or "")     try:         archive = fetch_zip(             f"{API}/repos/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{chosen['id']}/zip", token         )     except OSError as error:         return miss(output, f"base proof cache miss: could not download {name}: {error}")     if not place(archive, Path(proof_dir)):         return miss(output, f"base proof cache miss: {name} holds no {PROOF}/result.json")     message = (         f"base proof cache hit: {name} from run {run} "         f"{(chosen.get('workflow_run') or {}).get('html_url') or ''}".rstrip()     )     print(message)     result = {"hit": True, "message": message, "name": name, "run": run}     report(output, result)     return result   def miss(output, message):     print(message)     result = {"hit": False, "message": message, "name": "", "run": ""}     report(output, result)     return result   def main():     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()     parser.add_argument("command", choices=["name", "restore"])     parser.add_argument("--base-sha", required=True)     parser.add_argument("--digest", required=True)     parser.add_argument("--repo")     parser.add_argument("--proof-dir")     parser.add_argument("--token", default=os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN"))     parser.add_argument("--output", default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"))     args = parser.parse_args()     if args.command == "name":         print(artifact_name(args.base_sha, args.digest))         return 0     if not args.repo or not args.proof_dir:         parser.error("restore needs --repo and --proof-dir")     if not args.token:         parser.error("restore needs --token, GH_TOKEN, or GITHUB_TOKEN")     restore(         repo=args.repo,         base_sha=args.base_sha,         digest=args.digest,         proof_dir=Path(args.proof_dir),         token=args.token,         output=Path(args.output) if args.output else None,     )     return 0   if __name__ == "__main__":     sys.exit(main()) PY chmod +x scripts/base_proof_cache.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_base_proof_cache.py' 2>&1 | tail -20
